comment: I would not take BCOMM with her if you are a woman. She absolutely hates the way female voices sound and will take points off for it. If you present, be prepared for her to critique your voice rather than your content.

Regular homework is a chapter in the book. There is a quiz each class, which is easy. I averaged a B on those with minimal effort. The few bigger assignments are not hard at all as long as you put in a bit of thought and effort and pay attention to the instructions. Teaching is clear so all the info you learn feels super clear and straightforward.

I took her for Bcomm.  This class is painfully boring and has a lot of work but this is not her fault.  She has to teach it the way that the school requires.  A good teacher/person, but not a great class.  I am glad I took her though.

Professor Hillgrove has relevant experience working in communication. There are 3 papers which are graded harshly, but you are given the opportunity to rewrite 2 of them. There are also several public speaking assignments which could be intimidating to some. You're given a quiz every week based on 40-ish pages of reading, a lot for a .5 credit.

Quizzes every day, but if you read the book you'll be fine. Uses very outdated information considering it's a communication class and she isn't very good with technology. Can be mean and makes a lot of assumptions about people.

She's not as mean/scary as most of the reviews make her out be. The class is pretty boring but the assignments aren't terrible. She gives quizes off the textbook and they're kinda hard and you do have to read. Overall she's alright, I can't say I liked her but you can deal with her class to fulfill the requirement.
She is a very mean and stubborn person to deal with. Her lecture is very outdated and you will waste your college tuition if you taker her class.

The class is fine. You have to do the readings; there is a quiz based off the readings nearly every class. My main problem with the class was the prof's attitude; her feedback is really harsh and mean, and oftentimes really sassy and unnecessary. She offers rewrites for essays and makes the class interesting, but her feedback is really negative.

Hillgrove poorly attempts to teach business communication. The required readings are more helpful than the actual class. Her feedback is extremely critical and rude most of the time (Examples: yikes!, ouch, wow. what is this?).  Main Issue: she made very questionable (derogatory) remarks to some of the students

The class itself is pretty dull, mostly presentations of the do's and dont's of business communication, material that we have already read the night prior. Her feedback is not helpful and somewhat derogatory, but I will say (as a positive) I feel more confident in my public speaking abilities after this class.

Hillgrove is very narrow-minded, her way is the only right way to do things and your grades will reflect this. Being the class is business communications she should probably understand more about technology and not rely on outdated books. Her feedback on assignments range from "I hate this" to "what were you even thinking"

Prof. Hillgrove is pretty easy for B comm. There are weekly quizzes, but if you just skim the reading you will be totally fine (they are very general, could be figured out with common sense). She is very helpful and will make time to meet outside office hours. Expect work, but the class is very useful.

There is a whole bunch of stuff to do for a 1/2 credit but it's not impossible. As a professor, she is pretty average but that's the way the class is structured. Would not really recommend her but I also wouldn't discourage you from taking her.

Don't be fooled by what you read on here.By now you should know to take old reviews with a grain of salt.Hillgrove is a keen, witty and enticing professor who has a lot of field experience.If there is anyone to take Bcom with it is indubitably her.The class is fun, not burdensome, and helps you to become hands down a better business communicator!

class is required, so if you have to take it, it might as well be with her. she tends to talk a lot but always fair with rewrites and stuff. kind of boring but then again the class is business communications so i don't see how it could not be.
Professor is hard but engaging. Tells a lot of stories but they always get back to the point (eventually). Rewrites are key, make sure you take advantage of them. Not too bad for a 1/2 credit class.

Good professor, grading is kind of random but i'm pretty sure almost everyone walks out of the class with an A.  Its a pretty boring topic, so i think she did what she could with it.  it's required- so just take it, rewrite, and get your A

good professor, lets you rewrite which makes it a relatively easy to get an A or B.  Sometimes grading is iffy but again, doesn't really matter because you can rewrite til you get it the way she wants it
She is one of the worst professors I have ever had. She is not objective in grading, she does not respect her students, and she is obnoxious and rude. DO NOT TAKE HER.
terrible and obnoxious, biased against international students, will NOT stop talking ever, ever ever eveeeeer

Relatively good professor. While not always the easiest grader, Professor Hillgrove was always available for help. She also let us do a lot of re-writes, which helped bring my grade up from a D to a B. Read the assignment instructions!
pretty interesting class. lots of stories that helped keep me awake. homework was kind of confusing, but not too hard. she let you rewrite a lot which was helpful. i recommend this professor

One of the best teachers I've had here at UR.  She is  always prepared, gives great notes and shares great real-world stories with the class. It's obvious that this professor has actually lived what she is teaching! Her oral presenting abilities are outstanding and she engages the class since the first minute she walks in.

She is by far the worst professor at UR. She tells you how she wants you to do the hw the way in the book and then you get the hw back with a big 'C' on it and she tells you that she didn't want you to use the book. Her class is boring as hell and grades you down on the final for every little mistake, including clearing your throat.

The topic was interesting although if you pick a topic the teacher isn't interested in during your final topic you will not do well and make sure your emails to her are formal and proofread even if you are asking a short question.
